svg.title: Insert the whole memory, or select part of it
svg.desc: Two read paths side by side. Insert: the whole memory, here eight short entries, goes into the prompt with the request; no stored fact can be missed, but the prompt grows with the memory and stops at the context window, and the model must find the relevant lines among the rest. Select: a search compares the request (a trip for next weekend) with the stored entries and puts the three best matches into the prompt (lives in Berlin, runs on weekends, sister in Hamburg); the prompt stays small however much is stored, but the entry the answer needed (has a dog), which the request does not mention, ranks fourth and is left out. Under both, a design that does both: an index that is always in the prompt, and topic files read only when the index points to them, as in Claude Code.
